lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spots arranged in roughly linear vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. Columns contain approximately 4 to 7 local maxima each, following the vertical curvature of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of higher pixel intensity align with the vertical columns of circular spots, creating a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition from high-intensity dorsal pixels to shadowed ventral pixels.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep V-shaped notch or indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the primary pectoral fin, representing a significant loss of fin margin integrity.
other_distinctive_markers: Two small, lower-intensity silhouettes (likely commensal organisms) are visible attached or swimming adjacent to the ventral region near the pectoral fin base.
